about: Local CodeQL findings (codeql-scan-all, results-python.sarif) with their disposition, per security.md. Every finding is either fixed or listed here with a reason; GitHub default-setup CodeQL raises the same rules and those alerts carry the same dismissals.

fixed.fix: 2026-10-02: check_prerequisites() no longer appends str(e) to the errors list that /api/bitwarden/status returns; the detail goes to the server log. GitHub alert 76.

dismissed.comment: The printed values are pass/fail counts and redact_sensitive() output (masked, e.g. 'user****'), never the password. Matches GitHub alerts 1, 16-21, 39, 47, 48.

SHA-1 is the hash the HIBP Pwned Passwords range API requires for k-anonymity lookups: the client sends the first five hex characters of the SHA-1 and matches the suffix locally. SHA-256 would break the API contract. Every hashlib call carries usedforsecurity=False. Matches GitHub alerts 4, 22-24, 31-36, 55-58, 68-73, 75.
